Petkit Local keeps a connection to your server so alerts arrive even when the app is closed. Android shows a silent notification while it is on.

Battery optimisation can hold alerts back while the phone sleeps.

To save battery, Android cuts apps off the network while the phone sleeps, and alerts then arrive late. Petkit Local\'s connection is one quiet link to your server, about what a messaging app uses. Android will ask whether to let it run in the background.
